title: Nice Pillow
text: Nice Pillow. This is a nice pillow. It's a soft, plush pillow with diamond stitching. It doesn't have much of the typical Vera Bradley printed material, but the pillow does have a small border around it with the coordinating print. This pillow cover includes the insert which is appreciated. It seems to be of nice quality.
